evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasise governance, compliance, data lineage, and a single source of truth rather than shipping speed, e.g. 'collaborate with Data Governance to ensure data quality and compliance, contribute to metadata and data lineage initiatives'.
evidence.domain_risk: Strong understanding of telecom or commercial analytics, operational performance drivers
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect business/commercial decision-making at a telecom operator but the JD does not invoke financial reporting, regulatory, or audit language, so this lands as moderate rather than high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: promote a single source of truth for CBU performance
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role builds on an existing analytics stack, semantic layer, and governance tooling ('enhance the analytics stack and semantic layer') rather than establishing the function from scratch, indicating a mature data organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Proficiency in advanced SQL, data modeling, cloud platforms (preferably BigQuery), semantic modeling, and BI ecosystems
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The responsibilities and requirements name specific tools, platforms, and governance practices (BigQuery, DataGalaxy, dbt) with concrete application context, giving a clear picture of the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: collaborate with Data Engineering to industrialize and support self-service analytics
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary audience is the internal data function itself — Data Engineering, Data Governance, and self-service analytics consumers — rather than a single external business unit.
evidence.autonomy_level: you'll be the mastermind behind creating trusted, reusable, and analytics-ready data products
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic verbs dominate — 'own KPI definitions', 'shape the future of data at Orange Belgium and lead AI transformation projects' — indicating direction-setting rather than scoped execution.
evidence.ai_role: Prepare data for AI-driven analytics and natural language access, develop trusted datasets
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build data foundations for AI/LLM-based querying and conversational analytics, i.e. AI is downstream of their output.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality management and governance tools (DataGalaxy) appear in the requirements/skills list without an explicit ownership verb tying testing frameworks to the candidate's responsibilities, so this is tool_listed rather than responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Without your expertise, teams would still be stuck with fragmented KPIs, manual reports, and inconsistent data
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The role summary opens with an explicit risk register framing — fragmented KPIs, inconsistent data, lost trust — establishing high loss-aversion framing from the outset.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: enhance the analytics stack and semantic layer, and improve scalability, performance, and maintainability of solutions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The work extends and industrializes an existing analytics stack and semantic layer rather than building from zero, so this is fix_scale.
evidence.language_gate: Fluent in English (knowledge of French is also desirable)
evidence.loss_aversion: Without your expertise, teams would still be stuck with fragmented KPIs, manual reports, and inconsistent data — holding back growth, trust, and the future of AI-driven innovation.
